intructions.title: How to play
intructions.body_1: Complete each level by stacking sheep up to the window
intructions.body_2: Use the pants to catapult each sheep into the air
intructions.body_3: Click on the pants and move your mouse to select the angle and power
intructions.body_4: Release the pants and watch �em stack up to the window
